fact: The Federal Ministry of Health's strategic plan for 2022-2024 states that DHIS2 is used as an electronic platform for data collection and analysis at the locality level, and gives 2021 baselines from DHIS2 of a 46.9% reporting rate at primary health care level, 86.4% of selected hospitals using DHIS2 and a 72.4% hospital reporting rate, with the rollout of DHIS2 reporting at hospital level still to be initiated as an objective.
title: National Health Sector Recovery and Reform Strategic Plan (NHRR-SP) 2022-2024
